meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可启动本地 Dashboard 查看拆文库、写作项目和编辑文本。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、$story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 说句话即可唤起网文工具箱并打开工作台
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是网文作者，想从一句话快速进入写作工具箱。
copy.tagline_en: Route your writing request to the novel toolbox and open the local dashboard.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a web novel author wanting a single entry to your writing and editing tools.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成网文工具箱的路由入口：你的请求模糊时，它自动判断并转给对应的扫榜、拆文、写作、去AI味、封面等专用技能。还能启动本地 Dashboard 查看拆文库、写作项目，以及检查工具箱是否有新版本（只通知，不自动更新）。
howto.when: 当你用 /story、$story、/网文 等触发词，或说“我想写小说”“帮我写书”“检查更新”这类话时触发。意图不明确时，它会先询问你再分发。

say.text: 我想写本长篇，帮我开书、写大纲
say.note: 路由到写长篇技能，开始搭建故事框架。

say.text: 帮我检查一下工具箱有没有新版本
say.note: 它去查最新发布，只告诉你结果，不自动更新。

say.text: 把起点晋江的长篇排行扫一遍
say.note: 路由到扫榜技能，帮你搜集热门作品信息。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes the routing entry for a web-novel toolkit: when requests are vague, it auto-routes to skills for scanning, analysis, writing, de-AI-ifying, covers, etc. It can also launch a local dashboard and check for toolkit updates (notify only, no auto-install).
howto.when_en: Triggered by /story, $story, /网文, or phrases like “I want to write a novel”, “help me write a book”, “check for updates”. If intent is unclear, it asks before routing.

say_en.text: I want to write a long novel; help me open a book and outline.
say_en.note: Routes to the long-form writing skill.

say_en.text: Check whether the toolkit has a new version.
say_en.note: It checks the latest release and only informs you.

say_en.text: Scan the long-form rankings on Qidian/Jinjiang.
